leaves.name: carayolThmAIrr
leaves.doc: Carayol 1986, Theoreme (A), at F = Q, weight 2, packaged printed form over K_{f,lambda}, with Ribet's irreducibility and oddness (r17-print, r17-rebase): for a printed newform f (Tau Ceti Newform N 2) with number field K_f and a place lambda | l of K_f, there is a continuous rho : G_Q -> GL_2(K_{f,lambda}) (Mathlib adicCompletion), irreducible (no stable subspace other than 0 and K_{f,lambda}^2), odd (some involution c in G_Q has det rho(c) = -1), unramified at p not dividing N l with arithmetic-Frobenius trace a_p(f), whose Serre-Tate conductor exponent at every prime p != l is v_p(N). The passage to r17 (Burnside's form from irreducible + odd; IsNewform = printed newform; extension of scalars to Qbar_l; absolute irreducibility gives semisimplicity; conductor invariance under scalar extension and isomorphism; Brauer-Nesbitt with Chebotarev) is proved in Lean. Replaces r17.
leaves.flag: pending reading: the conductor clause is Carayol 1986 Theoreme (A) with Casselman 1973 unless a packaged print (Darmon-Diamond-Taylor 1997 Thm 3.1, Carayol section 0.8) states it; reading risk: Carayol 1986 Theoreme (A) as printed is local-global compatibility of rho_{f,lambda}|G_{Q_p} with pi_{f,p} through the local Langlands correspondence; the leaf's conductor clause (condExp = v_p(N) at p != l) follows from it only with Casselman 1973 (a(pi_p) = v_p(N) for newforms) and the conductor compatibility of the local correspondence (locator audit row R17 rates the conductor equality a CONSEQUENCE of these); it is printed as one statement only if the packaged form in Darmon-Diamond-Taylor 1997 Thm 3.1 or Carayol section 0.8 states it (UNVERIFIED); if the statement check finds the packaging unprinted, re-flag 'pending reading' (count-neutral) or fold the split form (CarayolExistence + CarayolConductor). Irreducibility is Ribet's plain form (Burnside's form proved in Lean from irreducible + odd); oddness from det rho = psi chi_l; locators UNVERIFIED
